gamerule.minecod.hand_mining.description: When off, blocks can only be broken from code: /run mine()
minecod.run.busy: A script is already running. Stop it with /halt
minecod.run.hung: The script stopped responding and was terminated. Your variables were reset.
minecod.help.title: Functions:
minecod.help.inspect: the block you are looking at, or nil
minecod.help.mine: break the block you are looking at
minecod.help.place: put the block you hold against the block you are looking at
minecod.help.use: right-click: the block you are looking at, or the item you hold
minecod.help.held: what is in your hand, or nil
minecod.help.select: switch the hotbar to a slot (1-9) or to an item
minecod.help.count: how many items you carry, of one kind or of all
minecod.notebook.placeholder: Lua that runs before your chat code. Define functions here, then call them: > tunnel(10)
minecod.terminal.placeholder: Lua program. Try: while true do mine() sleep(1) end
